attempted_claim: The topological conjugacy relation on pointed aperiodic binary Toeplitz subshifts whose maximal equicontinuous factor is the binary odometer and whose topological entropy is zero is Borel bireducible to isomorphism of countable graphs, hence Borel complete for S-infinity actions, with completeness witnessed by an explicit Hjorth-turbulent point with dense meager orbit.
claim_type: Borel-reducibility dichotomy with turbulence obstruction witness
decisive_failure: No complete TARGET resolution was reached: neither bireducibility nor its negation was proved for the pointed zero-entropy 2-odometer Toeplitz cell, and no turbulent witness was constructed. Bounded scripts (output/artifacts/verify_gadget.py, output/artifacts/turbulence_radius1.py, both VERIFY_OK) supply negative evidence only: the natural marker-fixed flip-invariant coding family collapses into the cited hyperfinite regime, and finite-radius search cannot witness Hjorth local-orbit density. An early unsound black-box impossibility argument was caught and retracted in-lane (WORKLOG section 6) before filing; no claim rests on it.
